tagline: French real estate developer and investor specializing in office and healthcare properties
hero_kpi_rationale: Leading French real estate company regularly distributing capital to shareholders. In 2025, total distribution of EUR 146.37 million (EUR 1.92 per share), comprised of SIIC dividends and merger premium distributions, reflecting shareholder remuneration policy and disciplined balance sheet management.

kpis.name: 2025 Consolidated Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net loss for financial year ended December 31, 2025, attributable to group shareholders.
kpis.description: 2025 consolidated accounts show net loss of EUR 123.03 million (group share), compared to annual accounts loss of EUR 20.96 million.

kpis.name: 2025 Total Shareholder Distribution
kpis.explanation: Combined dividend and capital distribution paid to shareholders from 2025 earnings and reserves.
kpis.description: Total distribution of EUR 146.37 million comprised of dividend of EUR 45.99 million and premium distribution of EUR 100.38 million, representing EUR 1.92 per share.

kpis.name: 2025 Distribution Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total gross distribution per share combining SIIC dividend and share premium reimbursement.
kpis.description: Distribution of EUR 1.92 per share comprised of EUR 0.6033 SIIC dividend and EUR 1.3167 share premium reimbursement, effective June 25, 2026.

kpis.name: Share Capital
kpis.explanation: Registered share capital of ICADE as of May 2026.
kpis.description: Share capital of EUR 116,203,258.54 as of May 2026, maintained at same level.

kpis.name: 2024 Distribution Per Share
kpis.explanation: Distribution per share in prior year for year-over-year comparison.
kpis.description: 2024 distribution of EUR 4.31 per share comprised EUR 1.16 eligible for 40% allowance and EUR 3.15 share premium reimbursement.

kpis.name: 2023 Distribution Per Share
kpis.explanation: Distribution per share in 2023 for historical comparison.
kpis.description: 2023 distribution of EUR 4.84 per share fully comprised of eligible dividend income.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 9.56 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of EUR 4.35 billion in latest year
